plain.li: [eating] {PAWN_nameDef} puts down {PAWN_possessive} spoon halfway through the meal.
[eating] {PAWN_nameDef} talks with {PAWN_possessive} mouth full and doesn't apologize for it.
[eating,!child] {PAWN_nameDef} waits until the others have food in their mouths and can't interrupt.
[inbed] {PAWN_nameDef} speaks up from under the blankets, wide awake.
[inbed,night] {PAWN_nameDef} sits up in bed in the dark and says it to the ceiling, loud enough to wake the next room.
[relaxing] {PAWN_nameDef} is meant to be resting, but has spent the time going over a list of complaints.
[relaxing] {PAWN_nameDef} has a free hour for once, and spends it on this.
[work:Cooking] {PAWN_nameDef} waves a ladle for emphasis, dripping soup on the floor.
[work:Cooking] {PAWN_nameDef} stops stirring, and the stew starts to catch on the bottom of the pot.
[work:Growing] Out in the field, {PAWN_nameDef} straightens up and wipes the dirt off {PAWN_possessive} hands.
[work:Growing] {PAWN_nameDef} stops halfway down a row of seedlings to call someone over.
[work:PlantCutting] {PAWN_nameDef} talks between swings of the axe, a few words at a time.
[work:Mining] {PAWN_nameDef} steps back from the rock face, gray with dust, and coughs twice before speaking.
[work:Mining] The pick stops, and {PAWN_nameDef} leans on the handle to talk.
[work:Construction] {PAWN_nameDef} gives the frame one last knock and climbs down to talk.
[work:Construction] Up on the half-built frame, {PAWN_nameDef} shouts it down to whoever is listening.
[work:Hauling] {PAWN_nameDef} drops {PAWN_possessive} load harder than necessary and speaks up.
[work:Hauling] Halfway to the stockpile with an armful of stone, {PAWN_nameDef} decides this is the moment.
[work:Cleaning] {PAWN_nameDef} has swept the same corner three times while working up to this.
[work:Research] {PAWN_nameDef} looks up from the research bench, where the same page has been open all morning.
[work:Doctor] Still washing blood off {PAWN_possessive} hands, {PAWN_nameDef} has a word with whoever is nearest.
[work:Hunting] {PAWN_nameDef} comes back from the hunt with a carcass over one shoulder and drops it at the kitchen door.
[work:Handling] {PAWN_nameDef} talks it over with the animals first, then comes to find a person.
[work:Warden] {PAWN_nameDef} comes back from the prison with an empty bowl and a request of {PAWN_possessive} own.
[work:Smithing] {PAWN_nameDef} sets the hammer down and waits for the anvil to stop ringing.
[work:Tailoring] {PAWN_nameDef} talks around a mouthful of pins.
[work:Art] {PAWN_nameDef} squints at the half-finished sculpture, then turns to whoever's watching.
[work:Crafting] {PAWN_nameDef} turns a half-made piece over in {PAWN_possessive} hands while {PAWN_pronoun} talks.
[work:Firefighter] {PAWN_nameDef} comes in from beating out the fire, still smelling of smoke.
[work:Childcare] {PAWN_nameDef} asks with a child on each knee.
[outside,rain] {PAWN_nameDef} stands in the rain with {PAWN_possessive} hood up and makes {PAWN_possessive} case.
[outside,snow] {PAWN_nameDef} stops clearing snow off the path and leans on the shovel.
[outside,night,clear] Out under the stars, {PAWN_nameDef} finally says it.
[inownroom] {PAWN_nameDef} calls someone into {PAWN_possessive} room to show them exactly what the problem is.
[indoors,storm] The walls shudder with thunder. {PAWN_nameDef} uses the moment of quiet after it.
[working,trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {PAWN_nameDef} raises it without breaking stride.
[working,trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {PAWN_nameDef} asks over {PAWN_possessive} shoulder and keeps working.
